about: Each land region's short text for the globe, written by hand from its fact sheet (region_profiles.py), keyed by the region's anchor. {key} shows a figure from the current fact sheet and [name] another place under its current name; rests_on holds the facts the wording rests on, and a text whose facts have moved past their tolerance is listed as stale until it is rewritten. Drafted at a lower setting from the fact sheets and reviewed and edited by the lead writer, 18 November 2026.

region:crater:W Bond.name: H'Ebeno Sotona
region:crater:W Bond.text: Crater after crater makes up this polar plain on the shore of [Uamoana]: {crater_floors} of its {districts} districts are old crater floors. Only {rain} of rain falls in a year, too little for any river to form. Earth stands {earth} above the horizon on average, high enough to light most of its nights.

region:crater:Poncelet@70,-157.name: H'Valo Laila
region:crater:Poncelet@70,-157.text: The largest region is also the driest, with {rain} of rain a year. Earth is in the sky over only {earth_share} of the land, and most nights are polar twilight, lit by the Sun just below the horizon, its light scattered down by the tall air. The arid heights climb to {highest} above [Uamoana].

region:lake:70.8,116.6.name: H'Montetim Luma
region:lake:70.8,116.6.text: Every district of these arid hills drains to [Yuldustengis], and their largest river, {river}, runs through [H'Lago Sotona]. Earth is in the sky over most of the land and never rises over the rest; twilight fills the polar nights. The tides on its coasts are small, {tide}.

region:lake:67.2,172.4.name: H'Keresto Aduma
region:lake:67.2,172.4.text: No coast touches this ridge country, yet all {districts} of its districts send their water to [Yuldustengis] across neighbouring lands. The ground rises to {highest} above the level of [Yuldustengis], and its largest river, {river}, runs through [H'Lago Semesa]. Earth stays below the horizon over nearly all of it, and its nights are twilit.

region:crater:Gerard Q Outer@47,-91.name: Altinyer
region:crater:Gerard Q Outer@47,-91.text: This high ground is semi-arid from end to end and stands {mean_height} above [Uamoana] on average. It gets {rain} of rain a year, and its {lakes} small lakes cover {lake_share} of it; no lasting river runs here. Earth shows above the horizon over under a third of it, and elsewhere the nights are twilit.

region:feature:Lacus Temporis.name: Yelyailau
region:feature:Lacus Temporis.text: One of the Moon's greatest rivers crosses this semi-arid land: {river} through the lakes of [Umutkoldor], dropping through one steep reach with {falls_total_gw} of falling water on its way to [Uamoana]. The coast faces [Yuldustengis] and, through the strait of [Eskibogas], [Uamoana] as well. The Hakuto-R Mission 1 crash site lies in the crater of [Yuldusoi].

region:ground:50.1,107.8.name: Tamasirit Ramal
region:ground:50.1,107.8.text: Rugged and arid, this far-side highland still holds some {lakes} lakes, and every one of its rivers, the largest carrying {river} through [Wadi Samas], runs to [Yuldustengis]. Its ground climbs to {highest} above that sea. Earth stays below the horizon over almost all of it, and the nights are twilit.

region:lake:37.6,172.2.name: Dungusiyenloko
region:lake:37.6,172.2.text: Some {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of this wet far-side country, and most of its water runs to [Hanakosa]. In [Siyensiyenloko] its largest river, {river}, drops through a single steep reach with {falls_gw} of falling water. Earth never rises here, and the nights stay dim, never quite dark.

region:lake:25.2,-125.6.name: Insi Yani
region:lake:25.2,-125.6.text: Landlocked and humid, this highland is scattered with {lakes} small lakes, none of them feeding a large river: the biggest carries {river}. Most of its water reaches [Uamoana] by way of neighbouring lands. Almost all its rain falls by day, and its far-side nights are dim.

region:feature:Montes Jura.name: Raamania
region:feature:Montes Jura.text: Across {waters} of [Uamoana] lie {land_pieces} islands and islets, the highest rising to {highest}. Earth stands about {earth} up over all of them, so every night there is lit by Earth, and tides of {tide} wash their shores. The land is broadly semi-arid.

region:lake:28.9,80.4@32,92.name: Uafenua
region:lake:28.9,80.4@32,92.text: Two heritage sites lie under [Atatahatai], off this wet lake country: Apollo 17 at Taurus-Littrow, and Lunokhod 2 with Luna 21. Onshore some {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of the land, and in [Maakusiyenloko] a river of {river} drops through a steep reach with {falls_gw} of falling water before reaching [Uamoana].

region:lake:16.3,134.8.name: Kiriguni
region:lake:16.3,134.8.text: Steep reaches with {falls_total_gw} of falling water break the rivers of this wet far-side land, where {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of the ground. Its coast lies on [Hanakosa], but most of the water leaves by other ways: to [Dagat na Kaseh], and to [Yuldustengis] by its largest river, {river} through [Midoriikeno]. No Earth shows in its sky.

region:lake:31.7,-156.5.name: Kumoikeno
region:lake:31.7,-156.5.text: Water leaves this landlocked lake country four ways, to [Yuldustengis], [Uamoana], [Bahari Masariki] and [Hanakosa], from ground that averages {mean_height} above the level of [Yuldustengis] and climbs to {highest}. It is wet, and {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of it. Earth never shows in its sky, and its nights are dim.

region:ground:30.4,-115.8@22,-100.name: Musitu Kiyani
region:ground:30.4,-115.8@22,-100.text: No region has a cloudier sky: cloud covers {cloud} of it on average, over land humid almost throughout. Every district drains to [Uamoana]; the largest river, {river}, runs through the lakes of [Masiwa Dunia], and two steep reaches in [Masiwa Dahabu] carry {falls_total_gw} of falling water. Earth stands low on the horizon over most of the land.

region:lake:17.7,-41.0@23,-38.name: Hamada Aswad
region:lake:17.7,-41.0@23,-38.text: Low and level, this arid plain lies on old lava basalt over {basalt_share} of its ground and stands on average barely {mean_height} above [Uamoana]. Tides of {tide}, among the greatest on the Moon, run in over its shores. Earth, {earth} above the horizon, keeps its nights lit.

region:lake:-9.1,-177.1.name: Paraorko
region:lake:-9.1,-177.1.text: These mountains have more steep reaches than any other region, {falls} of them with {falls_total_gw} of falling water, on rivers that run mostly to [Hanakosa]; the largest carries {river}. Lakes cover half the ground, and the land is wet. Earth lies far below the horizon, and the nights are as dark as a moonless night on Earth.

region:lake:0.8,-128.7@2,-120.name: Gubat na Gesem
region:lake:0.8,-128.7@2,-120.text: No country on the Moon stands higher: its ground averages {mean_height} above the level of [H'Yamo Melaha] and climbs to {highest}. Lakes cover {lake_share} of it, and its rivers fall through {falls} steep reaches, with {falls_total_gw} of falling water, on their way to [Bahari Masariki] and the salt water of [H'Yamo Melaha]. Its nights are fully dark.

region:ground:30.4,-115.8@14,-115.name: Masiwa Imvua
region:ground:30.4,-115.8@14,-115.text: Spread over {districts} districts, some {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of this wet and humid land. Its own shore is on [Bahari Masariki], but nearly nine-tenths of the land drains the other way, to [Uamoana]. Earth shows over a small part of it, and most nights are dark.

region:lake:5.0,-34.4.name: Karadala
region:lake:5.0,-34.4.text: Old lava basalt covers {basalt_share} of this semi-arid plain, the highest share anywhere, and nowhere does the land rise more than {highest} above [Bultengis]. A river of {river} crosses [Minggol] to [Bultengis], and offshore, under [Kokyaga], lies the Surveyor 1 landing site.

region:feature:Sinus Medii.name: Pooirimania
region:feature:Sinus Medii.text: Some {lakes} lakes, more than in any other region, lie on this wet basalt plain, and its water divides almost evenly between [Uamoana] and [Bultengis]. Earth stands high, {earth} above the horizon. Apollo 12 and Surveyor 3 lie in the crater of [Mata'isiyenloko], on dry ground.

region:feature:Lacus Lenitatis.name: Kohulim
region:feature:Lacus Lenitatis.text: Nowhere does Earth stand higher: {earth} up, almost overhead, lighting every night over this wet lake country. Offshore, under the waters of [Galtahatai] and [Pooiritahatai], lie two landing sites: Apollo 11 at Tranquility Base and Apollo 15 at Hadley-Apennine. Onshore some {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of the land, and nearly all of it drains to [Uamoana].

region:feature:Palus Somni.name: Honuaawa
region:feature:Palus Somni.text: Tides of {tide} rise and fall along this coast, among the greatest on the Moon. Behind it {lakes} lakes cover a quarter of the wet land, and all of it drains to [Uamoana] by rivers no larger than {river}. Its nights are lit by Earth.

region:lake:15.5,119.9.name: Lawalawang Anan
region:lake:15.5,119.9.text: [Dagat na Kaseh] receives every river of this wet far-side country, the largest carrying {river} through [Lawalawang Ale]. Lakes cover {lake_share} of the land, and no steep reach breaks the rivers' fall to the sea. Earth shows over almost none of it, and the nights are mostly dark.

region:lake:-15.5,-48.9.name: Tambarare Wingu
region:lake:-15.5,-48.9.text: The Luna 9 landing site lies on dry ground in [Imbuga Inyota], in a cloudy land of {districts} districts, mostly wet and humid, whose {lakes} lakes drain mainly to [Bultengis]. Earth stands {earth} up, yet at their darkest its nights fall below 1 lux.

region:lake:-16.5,43.7.name: Atafenua
region:lake:-16.5,43.7.text: Two heritage sites lie under lake water here: Apollo 16's Descartes site beneath a lake in [Abnufenua], and SLIM beneath another in ['Uo'uofenua]. Its coast on [Uamoana] has the greatest tides on the Moon, {tide} from low water to high. In this wet land {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of the ground, and Earth stands {earth} above the horizon.

region:feature:Mare Undarum.name: Musulim
region:feature:Mare Undarum.text: Facing [Uamoana] and [Dagat na Kaseh] almost equally, this wet country holds some {lakes} lakes over {lake_share} of its land, and its largest river, {river}, runs out through [Teiteimania] to [Uamoana]. Earth hangs low, about {earth} up, and the nights are mostly dim.

region:lake:-23.3,106.1.name: Asadani
region:lake:-23.3,106.1.text: More than half of this landlocked far-side upland is lake water: {lakes} lakes cover {lake_share} of it. Its water parts two ways, nearly two-thirds toward [Uamoana] and the rest toward [Dagat na Kaseh], and its sky never holds Earth.

region:lake:-22.7,135.5.name: Puyukosakuna
region:lake:-22.7,135.5.text: Lakes cover {lake_share} of this land, the largest share of any region, some {lakes} of them across {districts} districts. Their water is shared among four seas, [Hanakosa], [Uamoana], [Dagat na Kaseh] and the salt [H'Yamo Melaha], and no single river grows large; the biggest carries {river}. Earth is below the horizon everywhere in it.

region:lake:-19.2,-163.1.name: Pukutailakta
region:lake:-19.2,-163.1.text: From heights of {highest}, among the highest on the Moon, this wet land falls all the way to the salt shore of [H'Yamo Melaha], and every river runs the same way. On the way down they pass {falls} steep reaches with {falls_total_gw} of falling water, the strongest {falls_gw} in [Hatunlakta]. Lakes cover {lake_share} of the ground.

region:crater:Bullialdus.name: 'Ute'utepuke
region:crater:Bullialdus.text: A single crater rises out of [Bultengis], {area} of land amid {waters} of its own coastal water, its rim reaching {highest}. Small tides of {tide} wash its shore, and Earth stands {earth} above it.

region:lake:-17.4,12.7.name: Kungol
region:lake:-17.4,12.7.text: Four heritage sites lie here, more than in any other region: Apollo 14 at Fra Mauro, ashore in [Yulduskoldor], and under the sea the Luna 2 impact, Luna 24 and the Resilience crash site. Its semi-arid land lies in {land_pieces} separate pieces, scattered through {waters} of coastal water, more of both than any other region holds.

region:lake:-12.6,90.0.name: Vilima Alfayiri
region:lake:-12.6,90.0.text: Deep water lies off these humid hills, {coast_depth} on average in [Dagat na Kaseh], yet nine-tenths of the land drains away from that shore, to [Uamoana]. Lakes cover {lake_share} of it, and its largest river carries {river} through [Insi Dunia]. Earth sits on the horizon line, up over {earth_share} of the land and below the horizon over the rest.

region:lake:-19.2,161.9.name: Pakarinwaiko
region:lake:-19.2,161.9.text: The Moon's largest river runs here, {river} through [Intikosa] to [H'Yamo Melaha]. Its {falls} steep reaches carry {falls_total_gw} of falling water, more than any other region's, and the land ranges from wet to arid. Four-fifths of the water along its coast is salt; the rest belongs to fresh [Hanakosa].

region:lake:-33.3,-124.3@-36,-123.name: Muto Usiku
region:lake:-33.3,-124.3@-36,-123.text: Its coast lies on [Bahari Masariki], yet the largest share of this humid land drains to the salt water of [H'Yamo Melaha], and so does its largest river, {river} through [Insi Yiwe]; some water reaches [Bultengis] too. Some {lakes} lakes cover a quarter of the land. Earth barely shows in its sky, and its nights are dim.

region:crater:Lamarck.name: Musitu Dunia
region:crater:Lamarck.text: Earth stays low here, about {earth} above the horizon, up over nearly all the land, and the nights it lights are dim. Humid ground and semi-arid ground lie side by side, with {lakes} lakes over {lake_share} of the land, and a river of {river} crosses [Tambarare Yani] toward [Uamoana].

region:feature:Lacus Timoris.name: Yerdala
region:feature:Lacus Timoris.text: Its {districts} districts are all crater floors, semi-arid, with only small lakes and almost no running water: the largest stream carries {river}. Earth stands {earth} above the horizon and lights its nights. The ground rises to {highest} above [Bultengis], and all but one of its districts drain there.

region:lake:-29.5,64.1@-47,65.name: Tangyailau
region:lake:-29.5,64.1@-47,65.text: Day and night differ more here than in any other region, though only by {swing}. This landlocked, semi-arid upland holds {lakes} lakes on {lake_share} of its ground, and its largest river, {river}, runs toward [Uamoana] through the lands around it. Earth stands low, {earth} up on average, and lights most of its nights.

region:lake:-40.0,132.2@-46,132.name: H'Montetim Semesa
region:lake:-40.0,132.2@-46,132.text: Lakes string these semi-arid far-side hills, covering {lake_share} of the land. Their short coast lies on the salt water of [H'Yamo Melaha], but most of their rivers, the largest {river} through [H'Lagim Sola], turn the other way and reach [Uamoana] across other lands. Their nights are dim and Earthless.

region:island:-41.4,172.9.name: Abnupuehu
region:island:-41.4,172.9.text: The smallest region is a scatter of {land_pieces} islets, {area} in all, in the salt water of [H'Yamo Melaha]. The sea around them is deeper than off any other region's coast, {coast_depth} on average, and Earth never rises over them.

region:ground:-54.9,-88.9.name: H'Erso Sahava
region:ground:-54.9,-88.9.text: Across this semi-arid upland the nights come in three kinds, lit by Earth, twilit and dim, and Earth is in the sky over {earth_share} of it. In [H'Lagim Atika] a river falls through {falls} steep reaches with {falls_total_gw} of falling water on its way to [H'Yamo Melaha], and the heights reach {highest} above that salt sea.

region:ground:-41.9,26.7@-38,31.name: 'Irik Ahmar
region:ground:-41.9,26.7@-38,31.text: No coast reaches this dry country: most of it is arid, and its {lakes} small lakes cover {lake_share} of it, with no lasting river. Earth is up over all of it, {earth} above the horizon on average, and lights each night.

region:crater:Wilson.name: H'Harim Sabla
region:crater:Wilson.text: Arid mountains rise here to {highest} above the salt water of [H'Yamo Melaha], with {rain} of rain a year and neither lakes nor lasting rivers. No region has clearer skies, with cloud over only {cloud} of them, and most nights are polar twilight.

region:crater:Hedervari.name: H'Midbaro Tera
region:crater:Hedervari.text: Chandrayaan-3's landing at Shiv Shakti point and the Luna 25 crash site both lie on land here, in [H'Montetim Tera] and [H'Midbaro Kokava], two districts of an arid polar country. With {rain} of rain a year it has a single small lake and no lasting river. Earth is up over {earth_share} of the land, and most nights are lit by Earth.

region:crater:Chamberlin.name: H'Montetim Sahara
region:crater:Chamberlin.text: These arid hills get only {rain} of rain a year, and their largest river, in [H'Lago Luma], carries {river}. Along the salt water of [H'Yamo Melaha] the land lies in {land_pieces} separate pieces. The nights are twilit, and Earth stays below the horizon over almost all of it.

region:crater:Cabeus.name: H'Valo Luma
region:crater:Cabeus.text: Three heritage sites lie in the craters of this polar land. Two share the crater of [H'Erso Kokava]: the Lunar Prospector impact, which carried Shoemaker's ashes, and the LCROSS impact in Cabeus. IM-1 Odysseus stands in [H'Karatero Gesema]. The ground climbs to {highest} above [H'Yamo Melaha] and sheds its water almost evenly three ways, to [Uamoana], [H'Yamo Melaha] and [Bultengis].
